mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS id, u.name AS name, u.major AS major, u.grade AS grade, u.level AS level, u.avatar_gender AS avatarGender, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN uq.completed = TRUE AND uq.completed_at >= #{from} THEN q.exp ELSE 0 END), 0) AS periodExp FROM careermate_student_user u LEFT JOIN careermate_user_quest uq ON uq.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN careermate_quest q ON q.id = uq.quest_id WHERE u.university_code = #{universityCode} GROUP BY u.id, u.name, u.major, u.grade, u.level, u.avatar_gender ORDER BY periodExp DESC, u.level DESC, u.id ASC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(q.exp), 0) FROM careermate_user_quest uq JOIN careermate_quest q ON q.id = uq.quest_id WHERE uq.user_id = #{userId} AND uq.completed = TRUE AND uq.completed_at >= #{from}
